Container.Name: incipit-mongo
Container.Overview:
SET NETWORK FIRST. All three containers must share the SAME user-defined docker network, or container-name DNS does not resolve and the API exits at boot reporting MONGODB_URI. Unraid's default "bridge" does NOT resolve names.
MongoDB for incipit-api. Backs the inherited audnexus routes - author search, author/book lookup by ASIN, and chapters.
Deliberately publishes NO port: only incipit-api talks to it, over whichever user-defined network you put all three on. Set Network to your own below.
Start this BEFORE incipit-api. Unraid templates have no depends_on, and the API exits at boot if MONGODB_URI is unreachable.
Container.Requires: All three containers on the SAME user-defined docker network, so container-name DNS resolves. Unraid's default "bridge" does NOT resolve names.

Config.Name: Database storage
Config.Description: Mongo data directory. Keep this on the cache/appdata share - it is small but write-heavy.
